system.description:
A Frostbitten creature suffers the effects of extreme cold.

A Frostbitten creature takes 1d10 cold damage at the end of their for each rank they have, if they have not spent at least half of their movement moving into a new space before the end of their turns.

A Frostbitten creature cannot cast jutsu with the Combo keyword, or benefit from a jutsu’s Chain 2 or 3 effects.

Creatures that are immune to Cold damage is immune to this condition.

A Frostbitten creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends.
system.summary: 1d10 cold per rank at the end of its turn unless it moved half its speed; no Combo jutsu or Chain 2/3 effects; DC 20 Dexterity to end.

rules.text: The end-of-turn cold damage only applies if it didn't spend at least half its movement moving into a new space this turn: skip the card if it did. It can't cast Combo jutsu or benefit from Chain 2 or 3 effects.
